name: shunt
description: Token plane: delegation skills (bulk-read, code-write) that keep large-file I/O out of the main model's context. The enforcing hooks and the worker agents are Claude Code only.

interface.shortDescription: Route large-file reads and boilerplate generation to a cheap worker
interface.longDescription: A token plane for coding agents. Two delegation recipes: bulk-read sends whole-file reads of large files to a cheap read-only worker and brings back only structured bullets cited as file:line; code-write sends pattern-following generation (tests, configs, stubs) to a worker that writes straight to disk from a mandatory reference file. Under Claude Code the plugin also ships PreToolUse hooks that deny whole-file reads over a line limit and unbounded repo-wide content searches, pointing at the delegation path.
defaultPrompt: Bulk-read these files and list every public method with its file:line
Code-write a test file for this module using the sibling test as the reference
